title: Viva Engage: new post creation experience
summary: The briefing accurately reports the default-on publisher redesign, unchanged posting capabilities and lack of required admin configuration. Its licensing background and control gap are supported; retain the notice's expected-completion wording throughout and cite the additional source supporting post visibility.

claims.claim: Admins set view-only mode from the Viva Engage admin center.

claims.claim: Publisher and creation features are unavailable to users assigned to view-only mode.

claims.claim: Specify storyline creators limits who can create storyline posts rather than configuring the publisher layout.
claims.quote: This setting controls who has a storyline feed on their user profile and who can create new storyline posts. It doesn't restrict who can view, react, or reply to storyline posts made by others.

claims.claim: The destination selected for a post determines its audience.
claims.quote: By using public groups, anyone in the network can view content and participate in the group activity. ... By using private groups, you can limit membership and participation to invitation or approval only from group administrators.
claims.fix: Add https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/administration/viva-engage-networks-groups-and-users-overview to sources for community visibility; the already cited https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/engage/eac-storyline states that storyline content is visible to any internal user with access to Viva Engage.
